text: All work product, deliverables, and custom developments created by Provider in the performance of the Services shall be the sole and exclusive property of Customer. Provider hereby assigns to Customer all right, title, and interest in and to such work product, including all intellectual property rights therein. Such work product shall be considered a work made for hire to the fullest extent permitted by law. To the extent any work product does not qualify as a work made for hire, Provider irrevocably assigns all rights therein to Customer. Each party retains all rights in its pre-existing intellectual property.

Provider retains all right, title, and interest in and to the Software, including all modifications, enhancements, and derivative works thereof, whether created by Provider or Customer. Customer is granted a non-exclusive, non-transferable license to use the Software solely for Customer's internal business purposes during the term of this Agreement.

Contractor agrees that all inventions, discoveries, designs, and works of authorship created in the course of performing the Services are works made for hire and shall be the exclusive property of Company. Contractor hereby assigns to Company all intellectual property rights in such works. Contractor shall not develop, market, or sell any product or service that competes with Company's products for a period of twelve (12) months following termination.

Each party shall retain all rights in its respective pre-existing intellectual property. Neither party grants the other any rights in its intellectual property except as expressly set forth in this Agreement.

Vendor owns all right, title, and interest in the Platform, including all technology, algorithms, and intellectual property embodied therein. Customer is hereby granted a non-exclusive, worldwide license to access and use the Platform during the Subscription Term. Customer may provide suggestions, enhancement requests, or other feedback regarding the Platform. Customer agrees that all such feedback shall become the sole property of Vendor, and Vendor shall be free to use, reproduce, and commercialize such feedback without restriction or obligation to Customer.

All custom software developed under this Statement of Work shall be owned by Client. Developer hereby assigns all right, title, and interest in such custom software to Client. Developer retains ownership of its pre-existing tools, libraries, and frameworks ('Developer Tools'). Developer grants Client a perpetual, non-exclusive, royalty-free license to use the Developer Tools solely as embedded in the deliverables.

Company shall own all right, title, and interest in the Software and all related documentation. Licensee acknowledges that the Software contains trade secrets and proprietary information of Company. Licensee shall not reverse engineer, decompile, or disassemble the Software. Company shall place a copy of the source code for the Software in escrow with a mutually agreed upon escrow agent. In the event Company ceases to do business or fails to maintain the Software, the escrow agent shall release the source code to Licensee.

Provider grants Customer an exclusive license to use the Deliverables in the Territory for the Term. Provider shall not license the Deliverables to any other party within the Territory during the Term. All intellectual property rights in the Deliverables shall remain with Provider.

All materials, documents, and reports prepared by Consultant under this Agreement shall be works made for hire and shall belong exclusively to Client. Consultant retains ownership of its background intellectual property existing prior to this engagement. Consultant grants Client a non-exclusive, perpetual license to use such background IP solely as incorporated in the deliverables. Consultant shall assist Client in securing any patents, copyrights, or other protections for the deliverables.

The Software is provided under a subscription model. Customer does not acquire any ownership rights in the Software. Provider grants Customer a limited, non-exclusive, non-transferable right to access and use the Software during the Subscription Term.

All inventions, improvements, and discoveries made by Employee during the course of employment that relate to Company's business shall be the sole property of Company. Employee hereby assigns to Company all right, title, and interest in such inventions. Employee acknowledges that all copyrightable works created within the scope of employment are works made for hire. Employee shall not, during employment and for one (1) year thereafter, engage in any business that directly competes with Company.

Licensor grants Licensee a non-exclusive, royalty-bearing license to use the Licensed Technology for the purpose of manufacturing the Products. Licensee shall not sublicense, transfer, or assign the Licensed Technology without Licensor's prior written consent. All improvements to the Licensed Technology made by Licensee shall be jointly owned by Licensor and Licensee.

Provider retains all intellectual property rights in the Service, including all patents, copyrights, trade secrets, and trademarks. Customer retains all rights in Customer Data uploaded to the Service. Provider shall not use Customer Data for any purpose other than providing the Service. Each party's pre-existing intellectual property shall remain the sole property of that party. Customer may submit ideas, suggestions, or feature requests. Customer hereby grants Provider an irrevocable, perpetual, royalty-free license to use such feedback for any purpose.

Client owns all deliverables produced under this Agreement. Agency hereby assigns to Client all right, title, and interest in the deliverables, including all copyrights, trademarks, and other intellectual property rights. The deliverables are works made for hire. Agency retains ownership of its proprietary tools, methodologies, and templates used in creating the deliverables. Agency grants Client a non-exclusive license to use such tools solely as embedded in the deliverables.

Vendor shall retain all ownership rights in the Software platform. Customer acknowledges that no ownership interest is transferred by this Agreement. Upon request and payment of applicable fees, Vendor shall deposit a copy of the current source code with an independent escrow agent selected by the parties.

All intellectual property created by Contractor in the performance of Services under this Agreement shall be owned by Client. Contractor assigns to Client all rights in such intellectual property. Contractor shall not use Client's confidential information or intellectual property to develop competing products or services during the term of this Agreement and for six (6) months following termination.

Provider owns the Service and all technology underlying it. Customer is granted a non-exclusive license to use the Service. Customer may provide feedback, and Provider may freely use any feedback provided. Each party retains its pre-existing IP. Provider shall place the source code in escrow with Iron Mountain. The escrow agreement shall provide for release upon Provider's material breach or insolvency.

The parties agree to jointly develop the Product. Each party shall own all intellectual property that it independently creates. Jointly created intellectual property shall be jointly owned. Each party grants the other a non-exclusive license to use the jointly owned IP for the purposes of this Agreement.

All custom configurations, integrations, and workflows developed by Provider for Customer shall be works made for hire and shall be the property of Customer. Provider hereby assigns all rights therein to Customer. Provider retains all rights in its base platform, APIs, and standard libraries. Provider grants Customer a perpetual, non-exclusive license to use the base platform components as incorporated in the deliverables. Customer agrees that any suggestions for improving the platform shall become Provider's property.

Company grants User a limited, personal, non-exclusive, non-transferable, revocable license to access and use the Application for personal, non-commercial purposes. User shall not copy, modify, distribute, or create derivative works based on the Application.

Developer shall retain all intellectual property rights in the Software. Client shall have no ownership interest in the Software. Developer grants Client a non-exclusive, perpetual, irrevocable license to use, reproduce, and modify the Software for Client's internal business purposes.

All reports, analyses, and materials produced by Consultant shall be the property of Client. Consultant acknowledges that such materials are works made for hire. To the extent any materials are not deemed works made for hire, Consultant irrevocably assigns all rights to Client. Consultant's pre-existing methodologies and frameworks shall remain the property of Consultant.

Provider retains all rights in the Platform. Customer Data remains Customer's property. Provider shall not acquire any rights in Customer Data. Customer grants Provider a limited license to process Customer Data solely for providing the Service.

Subcontractor shall assign to Company all right, title, and interest in any work product created under this Agreement. Such assignment includes all patents, copyrights, and trade secrets. Subcontractor shall execute all documents necessary to effectuate such assignment. Subcontractor shall not engage in any business that competes directly with Company's core products during the term of this Agreement and for two (2) years thereafter.

Licensor grants Licensee an exclusive, worldwide, perpetual license to use the Technology for the manufacture and sale of Products. Licensee shall pay royalties as set forth in Exhibit A. Licensor shall not grant any other licenses for the Technology within the Field of Use.

All intellectual property rights in the deliverables shall vest in Customer upon creation. Provider acknowledges that all deliverables are works made for hire. Provider assigns to Customer any rights that do not automatically vest under the work-for-hire doctrine. Each party's background IP remains its own property. Provider grants Customer a non-exclusive license to use Provider's background IP as incorporated in the deliverables. Customer may submit enhancement requests, and Provider shall own all IP in enhancements to its platform.
The Software is licensed, not sold. Company retains all ownership rights. User is granted a non-exclusive license subject to the terms herein.

All designs, code, and documentation created by Agency for Client are works made for hire. Agency assigns all rights to Client. Agency retains its pre-existing creative assets and tools. Agency grants Client a license to use such pre-existing assets as embedded in deliverables. Agency shall deposit the final source files with a third-party escrow agent within thirty (30) days of project completion.

Provider owns all right, title, and interest in the Service, including all improvements and modifications. Customer acknowledges it has no ownership interest. Customer may provide feedback or suggestions, which Provider may incorporate into the Service at its discretion. Customer grants Provider an unrestricted, perpetual license to use any feedback provided.

Consultant shall perform the Services as an independent contractor. All work product shall belong to Client. Consultant waives any moral rights in the work product. Consultant represents that the work product will be original and will not infringe any third-party intellectual property rights.

Vendor owns all intellectual property in the Platform. Customer is granted a non-exclusive, non-transferable right to use the Platform. Upon termination, Vendor shall provide Customer with an export of Customer Data. Vendor maintains the source code in a secure escrow arrangement with a reputable third-party escrow agent for the benefit of its customers.

Customer shall own all custom development performed under each Statement of Work. Provider assigns to Customer all IP rights in custom development. Provider retains ownership of its standard platform and all pre-existing IP. Provider grants Customer a perpetual, non-exclusive license to use the standard platform components embedded in the custom development.

The parties acknowledge that each party owns its respective intellectual property. No transfer of ownership is intended by this Agreement. Each party grants the other a limited license to use its IP solely as necessary to perform under this Agreement.

All deliverables are works made for hire and belong to Client. Contractor assigns all rights to Client. Contractor shall not develop or assist in developing any product that competes with the deliverables for eighteen (18) months after termination. Contractor's pre-existing tools remain Contractor's property. Client acknowledges that suggestions and feature requests submitted to Contractor may be incorporated into Contractor's general product offerings.

Provider retains all ownership of the SaaS platform. Provider grants Customer a non-exclusive, non-transferable license to use the platform during the subscription term. Each party retains its pre-existing intellectual property. Customer may provide feedback and suggestions regarding the platform. All feedback becomes Provider's property without any obligation to Customer. Provider shall maintain a current copy of the platform source code in escrow with a nationally recognized escrow agent for the benefit of its subscribers. Customer shall not develop any product that is substantially similar to the platform during the term of this Agreement.
